As far as I can tell, x-posts are posts that are duplicates to an original post, but have to be made outside of the original subverse with people manually adding "X-Post from [Subverse]". I think they should all lead to the same, single post.

Say I made a post in /v/StevenUniverse, but it could also pertain to /v/Cartoons and /v/Music. I would need to make two extra posts instead of one single one. I suggest that when making a post, under the subverse option, have the option of putting multiple subverse separated by commas, but the post will only be made inside the first subverse listed.

Example:

Subverse: Creepy, Videos, News

With that, a single post would be made in /v/Creepy, but two posts would be made in /v/Videos and /v/News, but those two will lead to the post made in /v/Creepy. This way, smaller subverses can post links or discussions without having to go outside of their own subverse and increases the subverse's visibility and traffic. For subverses who do not want to be x-posted, probably put a option in subverse settings to opt out of x-posts.
